description: This file defines the Response class used for handling HTTP-like responses over Bluetooth connections, including response construction, header management, and data streaming.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP-like response with status code, headers, and content stream, with methods for sending over Bluetooth and converting headers.

classes.name: Response.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing Response objects with optional headers, status code, and content stream.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a header key-value pair to the response.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the content length from headers if available.

methods.name: toFileDetails
methods.description: Converts headers into a FileDetails object for easier access.

methods.name: toContentStream
methods.description: Returns the content stream if available, throws exception if not.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the response over a BluetoothConnection, including headers and content.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a Response object with the specified headers, status, and content.
